styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Dosas, filter coffee, biryani and craft beer.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Palaces, temples, markets and live music.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Lalbagh, Cubbon Park and a day at Nandi Hills.

stays.why: Central and on the metro. Walk to Cubbon Park and the shops; easy rides to most sights.
Best for food and nightlife. Many cafés, bars and restaurants within walking distance.
Young, lively area with cafés and startups. Good value stays; traffic can be heavy.
Quiet, local south Bengaluru. Close to Lalbagh and traditional food spots; metro nearby.

food: Start the day with a masala dosa and filter coffee at a stand-up 'darshini' — usually ₹60–150.
Try a South Indian thali (meals) at lunch: rice, sambar, rasam and vegetables, often ₹150–350.
Bengaluru is famous for biryani; ask your hotel for a well-known local spot and go early.
Indiranagar and Koramangala have craft breweries and cafés; expect ₹300–600 for a beer.
Street food like chaat and idli is cheap and tasty, but choose busy stalls and drink bottled water.
more_time: Day trip to Mysuru: trains take about 2–3 hours each way. See the palace and Devaraja Market; check times on the day.
Sunrise at Nandi Hills: hire a car with driver, leave very early, and check the weather before you go.
Half-day to Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace and the nearby markets for history and shopping.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the palaces, parks, markets and a food crawl; add a night for a Mysuru or Nandi Hills day trip.

month_notes: Jan: dry and mild, 16–27°C. Great for walking and parks.
Feb: warm and dry, 16–30°C. Very little rain.
Mar: hotter, up to 33°C. Start sightseeing early.
Apr: hottest month, up to 34°C. Carry water and rest at midday.
May: pre-monsoon showers, about 16 rain days. Keep an umbrella.
Jun: monsoon starts, about 21 rain days. Expect wet afternoons.
Jul: wettest month, about 24 rain days. Plan indoor sights.
Aug: still rainy, about 21 rain days. Cool and green.
Sep: rain continues, about 21 rain days. Check forecasts daily.
Oct: rain easing, about 16 rain days. Pleasant temperatures.
Nov: drier, 18–27°C. Good month to visit.
Dec: coolest and fairly dry, 17–26°C. Busy holiday season.

climate_guide.summary: Tropical highland city: mild all year, with a long monsoon from June to October.

items.title: Best time: November to February
items.text: Dry, mild days around 26–30°C and cool nights. Ideal for parks, markets and walking.

items.title: Hot before the rains (March to April)
items.text: Highs reach 33–34°C. Sightsee in the morning and stay shaded at midday.

items.title: Long monsoon (June to October)
items.text: Rain on 16–24 days a month. Expect short heavy showers; carry an umbrella and plan indoor backups.

items.title: May is the changeover
items.text: About 16 rain days as pre-monsoon showers arrive. Weather can flip within an hour.

items.title: Cool nights all year
items.text: Lows stay around 16–21°C. A light layer helps in the evening and in air-conditioned places.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light clothes, a rain jacket or umbrella in monsoon months, comfortable shoes for patchy pavements, and sunscreen.

transit.best: Use Namma Metro for long hops and ride apps or autos for short trips.

modes.text: Namma Metro has Green, Purple and Yellow lines; fares ₹10–90, smart card ₹50. Use it to dodge traffic.
BMTC buses cover the city but are slow and crowded at peak times.
Uber, Ola and Rapido work well; auto-rickshaws are cheaper for short hops.
Driving yourself is stressful; hire a car with a driver instead.
Walking is fine in small pockets, but pavements are patchy and traffic heavy.
